source: NCHS National Vital Statistics Reports vol. 74 no. 1, Table 2 and Table 11 — total fertility rate by race and Hispanic origin of the mother, 2023.
note: U.S. birth certificates do not record language spoken at home, so there is no official TFR by language. Hispanic origin is the closest published split for the largest non-English language community (Spanish). Non-Hispanic groups are single race. Rates are NCHS TFR per 1,000 women divided by 1,000.
